    let lines = db.lines_of_order(order.id)?;
findings.recommendation: Fetch the lines of every order in one query with the existing batch method `Db::lines_of_orders(&ids)` (`WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`, api/src/db.rs:30-33), then group them by `order_id` (e.g. a `HashMap<i64, i64>` of totals) and build the summaries in the original order of `orders`. Cost today: 1 + N queries per customer page view, N up to 100 — 101 round-trips on a user-facing path that runs on every view (proposal `## Domains`); after the fix, 2 queries whatever N. Keep the order of the summaries and the error behavior unchanged; orders without lines must still get a total of 0.
